name: Destroy Defense
reason: +2 to melee attacks applies only against targets wearing armor or using a shield, a target-dependent condition dnd5e cannot test.
proposal: Note-only utility activity, or MANUAL (an unconditional system.bonuses.mwak.attack +2 would be wrong).

name: Drunkard
reason: Con +1 and poison resistance are static; the 2d6 + level heal on drinking has 2 uses per long rest.
proposal: { activities:[heal 2d6+@details.level 'Drink'], uses:{max:'2',recovery:[{period:'lr',type:'recoverAll'}]}, extraEffects:[eff('Drunkard',{key:'system.traits.dr.value',mode:2,value:'poison'},{key:'system.abilities.con.value',mode:2,value:'1'})] }  // poison-save advantage and the 20 cap stay text unless Midi

name: Enhanced Technique
reason: Six technique upgrades, two of which are player-chosen, with situational riders (disadvantage on opportunity attacks, 19-20 crit for unarmed only).

name: Expanding Epiphany
reason: Resistance to psychic damage is unconditional; the 30 ft radius change and rage-only charm/fright advantage for allies are riders left as text.
proposal: eff('Expanding Epiphany',{key:'system.traits.dr.value',mode:2,value:'psychic'})

name: Fleet-Footed
reason: Already has an effect, and the shipped Fleet-Footed spec covers the +5 ft speed and +prof initiative; the Dex +1 and hop are choice/narrative.

name: Greater Enhancements
reason: Greater Enhancements is keyed to which Experimental Medicine formula is active (Hulking, Nimble, Resilient), so effects depend on a runtime choice.

name: In and Out
reason: +15 ft walk, no opportunity attacks and +2 to all saves apply only below half max HP, which a static effect cannot toggle.
proposal: DAE/Midi condition on hp.pct < 50 for system.attributes.movement.walk +15 and system.bonuses.abilities.save +2; otherwise MANUAL.

name: Inciting Inspiration
reason: Adds a second Bardic Inspiration recipient and +1 to Bard Creation attack/DC, both tied to other custom features rather than simple keys.

name: Intuitive Primate
reason: Already has an effect (climb = walk in batch2); proficiency, tool choice and size-for-carrying are choices/narrative.

name: Inventive Mind
reason: +1 to Gadgeteer creation attacks/DCs and extra Flash of Genius uses equal to proficiency bonus depend on custom creation items.

name: Legendary Flourish
reason: Three Bardic Inspiration reaction/attack riders (damage reduction, +20 ft movement and damage, attack bonus) plus temp HP on use; reaction-driven.

name: Medical Dissertation
reason: Extra healing equal to proficiency bonus on any HP restoration needs a hook into every heal roll; the +1 creation attack/DC is custom.
proposal: Add '+@prof' to heal activities of Medic creations only; otherwise note-only.

name: Mountain Stance
reason: Movement-conditioned stance with a spirit point reaction reducing damage by 1d10 + Str mod, plus size-for-grapple and advantage on grapple/shove checks.

name: Off the Ropes
reason: Climb speed equal to walk is unconditional, but the +1d6 per 10 ft height (max 10d6) and fall-damage negation depend on Savage Slam and situation.
proposal: eff('Off the Ropes',{key:'system.attributes.movement.climb',mode:4,value:'@attributes.movement.walk'})  // rest stays text

name: Ominous Toxin
reason: Con +1, advantage and poison resistance are static; the once-per-turn weapon poison is a Con save, DC 8+prof+Con mod, 2d4 poison, half on success.
proposal: { activities:[{type:'save',ability:'con',dc:'8+@prof+@abilities.con.mod',damage:'2d4 poison',onSave:'half'}], extraEffects:[eff('Ominous Toxin',{key:'system.traits.dr.value',mode:2,value:'poison'})] }  // skin-contact poisoned rider stays text

name: Rakish Audacity
reason: Initiative bonus equal to Cha mod is optional ('you can give yourself') and the Sneak Attack condition (alone within 5 ft) is situational.
proposal: MANUAL or note-only; ambiguous whether the init bonus should be always-on.

name: Reckless Brilliance
reason: Mad Genius and Bound Hulk apply only while not raging / raging, and the resistance is chosen when entering rage.
proposal: Rage-state toggles need DAE/Midi conditions; MANUAL.

name: Shandian Mobility
reason: Movement speed +5 ft is unconditional; the jump doubling is narrative, the ASI and skill proficiency are choices, grapple-escape advantage is conditional.
proposal: eff('Shandian Mobility',{key:'system.attributes.movement.walk',mode:2,value:'5'})

name: Strong Arms
reason: Extra 2d6 only on a hit in the first turn of combat, once per combat; situational and cannot be tracked natively.
proposal: Note-only activity; for size-for-carrying add {key:'flags.dnd5e.powerfulBuild',mode:5,value:'1'}.

name: Undead Resolve
reason: Necrotic resistance is unconditional; temp HP on necrotic damage and the Con save to drop to 1 HP are reactive riders left as text.
proposal: eff('Undead Resolve',{key:'system.traits.dr.value',mode:2,value:'necrotic'})

name: Unrelenting Fortress
reason: Temp HP equal to double proficiency bonus at the start of each turn applies only while raging in Forgemaster's Armor, and the resistance is a chosen type.
proposal: MANUAL (turn-start temp HP needs Midi/DAE and the chosen damage type).

name: Achilles Heel
reason: Spend 3 spirit points on an unarmed hit to impose a chosen-type vulnerability or suppress resistance for 1 minute, with a 24-hour lockout; choice-driven.

name: Advanced Combat Tactics
reason: Initiative bonus equal to Wisdom modifier (minimum +1) is unconditional; the in-combat check bonus and superiority die floor of 3 are riders.
proposal: eff('Advanced Combat Tactics',{key:'system.attributes.init.bonus',mode:2,value:'+max(@abilities.wis.mod, 1)'})

name: Afterimage
reason: Bonus action creates an Afterimage within 30 ft (same AC, 1 HP, immune to conditions) with teleport swap and attack-origin options.
proposal: { activities:[{type:'summon',activation:'bonus',range:30,profiles:[Afterimage 1 HP]}] }  // swap, attack origin and reaction opportunity attack stay manual; input text was truncated at 1300 chars, so later details are unverified

name: Animal Spirit
reason: Speaking with beasts/monstrosities is narrative and the Intimidation advantage is target-type conditional.

name: Aquatic Adaptation
reason: Breathing air and water is narrative/trait-level, and Athletics advantage applies only while in water.

name: Armed and Dangerous
reason: Medium armor and martial weapon proficiencies are static, but the Sneak Attack alternatives (grappled/deafened target, Str melee) and Cunning Action grapple are situational.
proposal: Effect: {key:'system.traits.armorProf.value',mode:2,value:'med'},{key:'system.traits.weaponProf.value',mode:2,value:'mar'}; rest text.

name: Aura of Freedom
reason: Aura gives allies within 10 ft (30 ft at 18th) advantage on saves vs paralyzed/restrained and ignoring difficult terrain, which native dnd5e cannot apply to other actors.
proposal: Active Auras if installed; else MANUAL.

name: Aura of Spite
reason: Aura gives advantage on opportunity attacks and ignores Disengage; a reaction-rule override dnd5e cannot express.

name: Aura of Tenacity
reason: Aura imposes disadvantage on enemy attacks against creatures other than you; needs target-relative checks no static effect provides.

name: Aura of Warding
reason: Aura gives resistance to the damage of creations within 10 ft (30 ft at 18th); creation damage is not a dnd5e damage trait.
proposal: MANUAL, or Active Auras with a custom flag.

name: Boomstick
reason: Proficiencies plus swivel gun property rewrites, Reckless Attack and Rage damage with ranged swivel gun attacks; weapon-level changes.

name: Brawling
reason: Brawling changes weapon ability, die, damage type choice and bonus-action strike, all conditional on being unarmed/unarmored.

name: Bullet Time
reason: Bonus action Bullet Time for 1 minute, uses equal to proficiency bonus, long-rest recovery, plus unconditional +prof initiative.
proposal: { activities:[{type:'utility',activation:'bonus',duration:{value:'1',units:'minute'}}], uses:{max:'@prof',recovery:[{period:'lr',type:'recoverAll'}]}, extraEffects:[eff('Bullet Time Init',{key:'system.attributes.init.bonus',mode:2,value:'+@prof'})] }  // reaction attack and save-half-on-fail are text

name: Burglar
reason: Dex +1, thieves' tools proficiency/expertise, lock DC boost and situational advantage on detecting secret doors and traps.

name: Caring
reason: Three d6 care dice recovered on short or long rest, spent to add to healing, grant temp HP equal to level, or add to Persuasion.
proposal: { activities:[utility 'Care Die' consuming 1 use], uses:{max:'3',recovery:[{period:'sr',type:'recoverAll'},{period:'lr',type:'recoverAll'}]} }  // regain on ally crit is manual

name: Carving Inspiration
reason: Advantage on melee weapon attacks until end of turn, triggered by giving Bardic Inspiration as a bonus action.
proposal: Utility activity with self effect (1 round) flags.midi-qol.advantage.attack.mwak=1 if Midi; else MANUAL.

name: Color of Observation Master
reason: Unsurprisable and waking are narrative, while the 2 Observation Point buff at turn start needs an activity consuming a custom resource.
proposal: Utility activity with self effect (adv on attacks/checks/saves, enemies disadvantage vs you) consuming 2 Observation Points; surprise part MANUAL.
